field.label: Enable Auto Rollback
field.help: Enable the auto-rollback safe mode feature.

field.label: Default Timeout (seconds)
field.help: Seconds to wait for confirmation before the system rolls back. Default: 120. Range: 30-3600.

field.label: Rollback Method
field.help: How to apply the restored configuration. Full reboot is most reliable (recommended). Service reload is faster but may not apply kernel tunables or interface changes.

field.label: Log Events
field.help: Log all safe mode and rollback events to syslog.
